command:
set -euo pipefail
set -a
. "$HOME/.config/omega/omega-mcp.env"
set +a
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, urllib.request
url='http://127.0.0.1:8789/mcp'
token=os.environ['OMEGA_MCP_TOKEN']
obj={'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':'receipt-e2e','method':'tools/call','params':{'name':'omega_receipt','arguments':{'person':'gabriel','command_id':'omega-effect-chatgpt-mcp-gabriel-status-e2e-70614664df504cb4','wait_seconds':0}}}
req=urllib.request.Request(url,data=json.dumps(obj,separators=(',',':')).encode(),method='POST',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept':'application/json, text/event-stream'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10) as r: reply=json.loads(r.read().decode())
p=reply['result']['structuredContent']
receipt=p.get('receipt') or {}
out={'ok':p.get('ok'),'state':p.get('state'),'command_id':p.get('command_id'),'machine_id':p.get('machine_id'),'owner':p.get('owner'),'receipt_status':receipt.get('status'),'receipt_boundary':receipt.get('execution_boundary')}
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
assert p.get('ok') is True and p.get('state')=='PASS'
assert p.get('machine_id')=='ai-core-node' and p.get('owner')=='gabriel'
assert receipt.get('machine_id')=='ai-core-node' and receipt.get('owner')=='gabriel'
assert receipt.get('command_id')==p.get('command_id')
PY
